title: Mac OS X Leopard website, 2007
lede: Apple’s Mac OS X Leopard page as archived in November 2007.
summary: Silver gradient navigation, an aurora wallpaper on laptop screens, and a reflective floor.

evidence.note: Captured from the Internet Archive with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 25 September 2026 and inspected. The archived page may lack some images or scripts that the live page had.

styles.note: Part of the Aqua line that precedes the style: the aurora wallpaper, glossy blue pill buttons, and reflections under the hardware.

observed: A silver gradient navigation bar with a darker selected tab.
Three MacBooks show the purple-pink aurora wallpaper, standing on a white floor with soft reflections.
Small blue pill buttons with a gloss highlight (Watch the guided tour, Buy Now).
A glossy disc with a galaxy image and a presenter photo promote the guided tour.
interpretation: Shows the Apple side of the lineage. It is more silver and cosmic than the sky-and-grass Microsoft examples, closer to Aqua than to the later Frutiger Aero imagery.

images.alt: Archived Mac OS X Leopard page: a silver navigation bar, the headline “Add a new Mac to your Mac.”, three laptops showing a purple aurora wallpaper standing on a reflective white floor, and glossy blue pill buttons.
images.caption: First viewport of the [November 2007 archived copy](https://web.archive.org/web/20071101131506/http://www.apple.com/macosx/).
